root_cause: Hardcoded workspace IDs prevented AI configuration discovery after server restart

details.problem: Frontend used hardcoded workspace IDs (dashboard.js: '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', ai-config.js: 'ws-001') that never matched actual workspace UUIDs after restart + re-auth
symptoms: After server restart, all provider queries returned empty
fix: Added GET /api/v1/workspaces endpoint returning tenant's workspaces + default_workspace_id
Added V5D.Projects.getWorkspaceId() with 3-tier discovery: sessionStorage cache → backend API → auto-create
Updated ai-config.js to use dynamic WS_ID via _getWS()
All 4 callers of _getWorkspaceId() updated for async

verification.restart_simulation: PASS — re-auth finds same user, workspace auto-discovered, provider listed
verification.auto_create_fallback: PASS — new tenant with 0 workspaces auto-creates one
